page.overview:
Who is Am I Savage??

Am I Savage? is the tenth track from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

As the title suggests, the subject matter about inherited curses, family problems, and losing who you are. It draws inspiration from James Hetfield's ideas about being a dad and how anger is like a gift passed down from his father. It also connects to the werewolf legend, making us wonder if he's turning into the monster he battles in his son. This theme is reflected in the creepy music video with faceless characters and a main character who is mentally falling apart.

Ooooh, Run away, the past will bite again Ooooh, No matter where you dwell You, Here again, a captive of the howl You, Welcome back to hell

Faithful, as the full moon is rising Beauty and the Beast are colliding
